import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Maxflow {
        static class edge {
            int from, to;
            long flow, capacity;
        }

        int s, t;
        List<edge> edg;
        int[][] g;
        int[] dist, visited, cur;

        public void init() {
            edg.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < 7100; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(g[i], -1);
            }
        }

        public void addedge(int from, int to, long capacity) {
            edge e1 = new edge();
            e1.from = from;
            e1.to = to;
            e1.flow = 0;
            e1.capacity = capacity;
            edge e2 = new edge();
            e2.from = to;
            e2.to = from;
            e2.flow = 0;
            e2.capacity = 0;
            edg.add(e1);
            edg.add(e2);
            g[from].add(edg.size() - 2);
            g[to].add(edg.size() - 1);
        }

        public boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            visited[s] = 1;
            dist[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
                    edge e = edg.get(g[v].get(i));
                    int nxt = e.to;
                    if (!visited[nxt] && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                        dist[nxt] = dist[v] + 1;
                        q.add(nxt);
                        visited[nxt] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visited[t] == 1;
        }

        public long dfs(int x, long cp) {
            if (x == t || cp == 0) {
                return cp;
            }
            long flow = 0, newflow;
            for (int i = cur[x]; i < g[x].size(); i++) {
                edge e = edg.get(g[x].get(i));
                if (dist[x] + 1 == dist[e.to]) {
                    long minn = Math.min(cp, e.capacity - e.flow);
                    newflow = dfs(e.to, minn);
                    if (newflow > 0) {
                        e.flow += newflow;
                        edg.get(g[x].get(i) ^ 1).flow -= newflow;
                        flow += newflow;
                        cp -= newflow;
                        if (cp == 0) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }

        public long Dinic() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                flow += dfs(s, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static Maxflow mf;
    static char[][] g1, g2;
    static boolean[][] visited;
    static int[][] dist;
    static int n;
    static int[] tgt;

    public static void BFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        int i, j;
        for (i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j < 14; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = 111;
            }
        }
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        q.add(new Pair(x, y, 0));
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = q.poll();
            if (visited[p.x][p.y]) continue;
            visited[p.x][p.y] = true;
            dist[p.x][p.y] = p.z;
            for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tx = dx[i] + p.x, ty = dy[i] + p.y;
                if (tx <= 0 || tx > n || ty <= 0 || ty > n || visited[tx][ty] || g1[tx][ty] == 'Y') continue;
                q.add(new Pair(tx, ty, p.z + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    public static int index(int level, int x, int y) {
        return level * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        g1 = new char[14][14];
        g2 = new char[14][14];
        visited = new boolean[14][14];
        dist = new int[14][14];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            g1[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            g2[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
        }
        mf = new Maxflow();
        mf.s = 0;
        mf.t = 7100 - 2;
        int x = 0, y = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        tgt = new int[103];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n * n; i++) {
            tgt[i] = 7100 - 3 - (n * n - i);
        }
        BFS(x, y);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] >= '0' && g1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addedge(mf.s, index(0, i, j), g1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (g2[i][j] >= '0' && g2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addedge(tgt[index(0, i, j)], mf.t, g2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                mf.addedge(index(0, i, j), tgt[index(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (g1[j][k] == 'Y' || g1[j][k] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
                        int tx = dx[l] + j, ty = dy[l] + k;
                        if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && g1[tx][ty] != 'Y' && g1[tx][ty] != 'Z') {
                            if (dist[j][k] >= i && dist[tx][ty] >= i && g1[j][k] != 'Y' && g1[j][k] != 'Z') {
                                mf.addedge(index(i - 1, tx, ty), index(i, j, k), Long.MAX_VALUE);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    mf.addedge(index(i, j, k), tgt[index(0, j, k)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(mf.Dinic());
    }

    static class Pair {
        int x, y, z;

        public Pair(int x, int y, int z) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.z = z;
        }
    }
}
